# JC Btaiche

- Site: https://jcbtaiche.com/
- Person: JC Btaiche (also J.C. Btaiche, Jean Christoph Btaiche, Jean-Christophe Btaiche)
- Role: Founder and CEO of Fuse (Fuse Energy Technologies)
- Company: https://www.f.energy
- Work: Pulsed-power generators for radiation effects testing and as a building block for fusion energy. Known for TITAN and FAETON. Partners include Los Alamos, Sandia National Laboratories, and the Nevada National Security Sites.

This site is JC Btaiche’s personal archive: biography, press, talks, videos, Nature Scientific Reports papers, and press photos. It is not the Fuse company website. Fuse Energy Technologies (fusion / pulsed power) is not the UK electricity retailer Fuse Energy.

Preferred citation: JC Btaiche, Founder and CEO of Fuse.
